versions.changelog: Made commute routing deterministic so simulated commuting flows follow the national journey-to-work matrix directly and are identical from build to build, added drivable "living street" roads, and thinned building foundations at lower zoom levels.
Refreshed every Polish map with per-building foundation depth and refined coastal bathymetry.
Broadened Polish worker totals with a census-based employment measure for better rural coverage, and added hospital, military-base, and ferry-terminal demand.
Rebalanced how commuters spread across workplaces in the Polish maps, expanded building coverage to stadiums and infrastructure, and added neighbourhood-level place labels.
Initial release of the Warszawa map with census-based residents and workers on real building footprints and a full range of demand points.
